name: DeVonta Smith
notes: Makai Lemon and DeVonta Smith aren't practicing Tuesday due to hamstring injuries. Neither injury is considered long-term.

name: Zay Flowers
notes: Zay Flowers considered day-to-day with quad contusion, per HC Minter.

name: Jaylen Waddle
notes: HC Sean Payton said Jaylen Waddle (leg) has a strain and expects him to be back in the next 4-5 days.

name: Luther Burden III
notes: Luther Burden limped off practice field with a trainer Saturday after landing awkwardly during a 1-on-1.

name: Mike Evans
notes: Mike Evans (quad strain), Kaelon Black (adductor) not participating in practice Monday.

name: Cam Skattebo
notes: Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo (leg) just part of working back from last year's injury and is "ok."

name: Tucker Kraft
notes: OC Stenavich said he's hopeful Tucker Kraft (knee) will be ready to play Week 1, per Ryan Wood.

name: Patrick Mahomes II
notes: Reid: Chiefs "leaning against" playing Patrick Mahomes (knee) in preseason opener, via Sam McDowell.

name: Kyle Monangai
notes: Johnson: Kyle Monangai considered "day-to-day" with soft tissue injury. Doesn't sound like it'll be long term.

name: Xavier Worthy
notes: Reid: Xavier Worthy expected to practice later this week after suffering sprained shoulder. Cyrus Allen (shin) also expected to return.

name: KC Concepcion
notes: Schultz: KC Concepcion's shoulder injury isn't "serious" and Browns expect him to be fine.

name: Jalen McMillan
notes: Bowles: Jalen McMillan (knee) without timeline for return. LT Tristan Wirfs (hamstring) expected to return during preseason.

name: Kenyon Sadiq
notes: Kenyon Sadiq (hernia) expected to be ready for Week 1 but will miss "a couple weeks."

name: Trey Benson
notes: HC LaFleur: Trey Benson dealing with discomfort in left knee; not expected to be a multi-week issue.

name: Kaelon Black
notes: Mike Evans (quad strain), Kaelon Black (adductor) not participating in practice Monday.

name: Cyrus Allen
notes: Reid: Xavier Worthy expected to practice later this week after suffering sprained shoulder. Cyrus Allen (shin) also expected to return.
